intro.label: Hair Restoration
intro.title: Recover the appearance of your hair. Recover confidence in your image.
items: Every time you look in the mirror, do you notice receding hairlines, less density, or a hairline that doesn't look like before?
Hair loss doesn't always stay in the mirror. It can make you feel less confident in photos, meetings, social activities, or simply when you want to feel comfortable with your own image again.
And perhaps you have already tried shampoos, supplements, products, or different treatments hoping to recover the appearance you had before.
But when hair loss is already evident, you need more than just covering up the problem. There is an alternative: Hair Transplant.

box.title: Hair Transplant in Costa Rica
box.p1: At MJ Estética & Wellness Center, in Costa Rica, we offer a personalized evaluation to determine if a hair transplant may be an appropriate option for you and design a protocol according to your characteristics and goals.
box.p2: Our goal is to help you achieve a natural, harmonious hair appearance that fits your face, through a professional and personalized process.

whatIs.title: What is a Hair Transplant?
whatIs.p1: A hair transplant is a hair restoration procedure that consists of transferring hair follicles from a donor area to areas where there is loss or lower density.
whatIs.p2: The purpose is to visually improve the appearance of hair density, redefine certain areas of the hairline, and achieve a natural aesthetic integration. There is no universal design. Each person has a different pattern, different density, unique facial features, and a different donor area, as well as their own expectations and aesthetic goals.

recommended.title: What if you could feel comfortable with your image again?
recommended.desc: Imagine being able to look in the mirror and feel that your hair is part of your appearance in a natural way. We do not simply seek to 'put more hair'. We seek to create a restoration that makes sense for your face, your age, your loss pattern, and your individual characteristics. The goal is for the result to look like you: Natural, Progressive, and Harmonious.

timeline.title: When will you start noticing changes?
timeline.p1: One of the greatest expectations of anyone considering a hair transplant is wanting to see results quickly. However, hair has its own growth cycle.
timeline.p2: Therefore, results develop progressively and can vary considerably among patients.
timeline.p3: Your evolution will depend on individual factors and compliance with post-care recommendations. The key is to have realistic expectations and understand that hair restoration requires time, patience, and professional follow-up.

items.q: Who is a candidate for a hair transplant?
items.a: Candidacy depends on factors such as loss pattern, donor area availability, density, individual characteristics, and expectations. A professional assessment is necessary.

items.q: Can it be combined with other hair treatments?
items.a: Depending on the diagnosis and the patient's needs, there may be different complementary strategies. Any combination must be determined individually during the assessment.
